note: Traumasoft employee -> Paycor employee id, for people the employee_num
join cannot resolve on its own.
push_paycor_timecards.py normally matches a Traumasoft employee to a
Paycor one by employee_num, compared case-insensitively against the
Paycor roster. You only need a line here when that fails, and the dry
run names exactly who those people are:
- a Traumasoft employee carrying no employee_num at all
- an employee_num that matches nothing in Paycor, because the two
- an employee_num that matches SEVERAL Paycor employees, which is
refused rather than guessed at -- paying the wrong person is the
one failure this script must never make quietly
The key is either the Traumasoft employee_num, or 'user_id:<n>' when
the person has no employee_num to key on. The value is the Paycor
employee id, which is what the API addresses a punch to -- not their
employee number, unless Paycor happens to use the same string for both.
